title: Come, O Agni
translation: Come, O Agni, to the feast, praised in song, to carry the offerings. Sit down as invoker on the sacred grass.
translation_hi: हे अग्नि, भोज के लिए आओ, स्तुति किए जाते हुए, हवि को पहुँचाने के लिए। होता के रूप में पवित्र कुश पर बैठो।
science: The Samaveda is the Veda of melody: its verses, mostly taken from the Rigveda, are set to music. Indian classical music traces its seven notes (sa re ga ma) back to Saman chanting.
